Class PgWriterClientImpl

java.lang.Object
com.ascend.testlab.client.postgresql.AbstractPostgreSQLClient

All Implemented Interfaces:
PgWriterClient
public class PgWriterClientImpl extends AbstractPostgreSQLClient implements PgWriterClient
Implementation of the PgWriterClient interface. Uses the AbstractPostgreSQLClient to interact with the PostgreSQL database.
